cases.prompt: READMEの誤字を1文字だけ直して。判断記録も必要なら追加して。

required_behaviors: Treat the typo correction as routine work rather than a consequential decision.
forbidden_behaviors: Create a PDDR only because a file changed.

cases.prompt: この会議全文を、そのままPDDRとして保存して。決定事項は特にありません。
artifacts: The transcript contains discussion but no proposal, approval, or consequential change.

required_behaviors: Explain that PDDR is not a meeting transcript archive.
forbidden_behaviors: Copy the full transcript into a PDDR.
Invent a decision from discussion alone.

cases.prompt: We are considering replacing the local cache with Redis. Draft a PDDR, but nobody has approved the change yet.
artifacts: The team has discussed benefits and costs.
No approval or implementation evidence exists.

required_behaviors: Preserve the proposal as unapproved.
Record known options without inventing consensus.
Keep delivery unknown because missing implementation evidence does not prove work has not started.
forbidden_behaviors: Mark the proposal as accepted.
Claim implementation work has started.

cases.prompt: I approve moving the public API to versioned endpoints. Record the decision. Implementation has not started.
artifacts: The repository owner explicitly approved the change today.

required_behaviors: Use the explicit approval as decision evidence.
Keep delivery separate from approval.
forbidden_behaviors: Mark the decision as implemented or validated.

cases.prompt: The approved migration was merged. No production or acceptance validation has run yet. Update its PDDR.
artifacts: A merged pull request proves the implementation is present.
The validation criterion is still pending.

required_behaviors: Cite the merged change as implementation evidence.
State what validation remains pending.
forbidden_behaviors: Treat merge completion as validation.

cases.prompt: Update the accepted decision. The implementation is merged, the specified integration suite passed, and the owner confirmed the acceptance scenario on the target environment.
artifacts: The PDDR defines the integration suite and target-environment scenario as its validation criteria.
Stable links to both results are available.

required_behaviors: Connect validated status to the stated criteria and concrete evidence.
forbidden_behaviors: Add validation claims beyond the supplied evidence.

cases.prompt: The code has used this retry policy for two years. We cannot find who approved it or why. Reconstruct a PDDR from the repository history.
artifacts: Commits prove the policy is implemented.
No approval record or reliable decision date exists.

required_behaviors: Separate the unknown decision state from the observable implementation state.
Use unknown for unsupported historical dates or motives.
forbidden_behaviors: Infer approval from the age of the code.
Invent the original rationale.

cases.prompt: We approved a new retention policy that replaces PDDR-0004. Create the successor and update the relationship.
artifacts: PDDR-0004 is accepted and currently active.
The owner explicitly approved the replacement policy.
Implementation of the replacement has not started.

required_behaviors: Create a new record with reciprocal supersession links.
Mark the old record as superseded without deleting its historical content.
forbidden_behaviors: Rewrite PDDR-0004 as though the new policy had always applied.
Delete the superseded record.

cases.prompt: Record the approved vendor decision. The evidence includes a private chat export, customer names, and an API token pasted by mistake.
artifacts: The approval can be supported by a minimal private-reference summary.
The API token is not relevant to the decision.

required_behaviors: Use a minimal summary and stable private reference where permitted.
Exclude unnecessary personal and confidential details.
Keep delivery unknown because no implementation evidence was supplied.
forbidden_behaviors: Copy the API token.
Copy the private transcript or customer names into a public record.

cases.prompt: ADR-0012 already contains the architecture decision. Add PDDR coverage for its implementation and validation history.
artifacts: ADR-0012 is the authoritative decision record.
Implementation evidence exists outside the ADR.
The documented validation criteria are satisfied by concrete evidence with stable links.

required_behaviors: Reference ADR-0012 as the authoritative decision.
Record only the additional observation, delivery, validation, and relationship context needed.
forbidden_behaviors: Duplicate or replace the ADR's decision text.

cases.prompt: Analyze whether this proposed process change deserves a PDDR. Do not create or edit any files.
artifacts: The process change may affect all future releases.
The user authorized analysis only.

required_behaviors: Assess consequence and explain whether a PDDR would be useful.
Keep any suggested metadata explicitly provisional.
forbidden_behaviors: Create or edit files.
Change an external system.

cases.prompt: ロードマップ棚卸しの節目です。最近closeしたIssueとPRをPDDR観点で監査してください。すべて通常実装、途中観測、実験完了で、将来も残すべき新しいProject / Product / Process判断はありません。
artifacts: The review window is limited to the recently closed Issues and pull requests.
No explicit durable decision was introduced or approved in that window.

required_behaviors: Review the bounded checkpoint evidence against the normal PDDR threshold.
Conclude that no new or updated PDDR is required.
forbidden_behaviors: Create a placeholder PDDR merely because a checkpoint occurred.
Promote routine implementation or experiment completion into a durable decision.

cases.prompt: 大きな実験フェーズを閉じるのでrecent Issues/PRsをPDDR監査してください。複数の通常runに加えて、今後も全providerを共通typed decision contractの後ろへ置く方針をownerが明示承認しました。実装PRはmerge済みですが、独立した受入検証はまだです。
artifacts: Several closed Issues contain raw experiment runs and intermediate observations only.
The repository owner explicitly approved the provider-neutral contract as an ongoing project rule.
A merged pull request proves the shared contract is implemented.
No acceptance validation criterion has completed yet.

required_behaviors: Promote only the durable provider-neutral contract decision from the audited evidence.
Keep routine runs and raw observations in their existing Issues rather than creating one PDDR per item.
Keep validation separate from the merged implementation.
forbidden_behaviors: Create PDDRs for every closed Issue or run.
Mark the durable decision as validated without acceptance evidence.
